title: bumelia peckhamensis
intro: Bumelia peckhamensis, commonly known as the Jamaican dogwood or Mexican dogwood, is a plant species in the family Sapotaceae. The health benefits of Bumelia peckhamensis include its use as a sedative and anxiolytic, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antispasmodic, which can help to alleviate muscle spasms and cramps, and its sedative properties can aid in the treatment of insomnia and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Bumelia peckhamensis include alkaloids, such as laudanosine and laudanosine-3, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
